tei:div.tei:p: "$ (441)༄༅// klong sde rdo rje zam pa las/ nyams len bzhi'i rnal 'byor dang he ru ka mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i phrin las gsal bar bkod pa ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(442)༄༅// na mo gu ru ma hā shrī he ru kā ya/ chos kun ye nas dag pa'i klong chen por// ma skyes rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i dpal chen po// bde chen mdangs shar dbyings kyi yum dang bcas// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshul du bstan la 'dud: /gsang chen yang rtsi grub mchog gi: thugs kyi thig le mtshan tsam yang*// rnyed dka' shin tu rnal 'byor gyi: dkyil 'khor las rim bltas chog dgod// rdzogs pa chen po sde gsum gyi nang tshan klong sde zam pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la bzhir gsungs te/ ma dag pa dag par byed pa rgya mtsho khrus kyi lung*/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa sgo gsum las kyi spyod pa/ ma grol ba grol bar byed pa sgom tshul bla ma'i byin brlabs/ grol ba mthar phyin par byed pa snying po ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ro// de la thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba khrus lung la gnyis/ phyi nang*/ nang ngo*// dang po ni/ stegs la tshom bu lnga bkod pa'i steng du rin po che'i bum par a mṛ ta dang glang rtsi min pa'i spos sna nyer lnga'i rdzas dang chu gtsang gis bltams pa mgul chings kha rgyan gzungs thag bcas (443) bzhag /bdag gi thugs kar oṃ yig kha dog lnga ldan du gsal/ oṃ swa bhā ba bi shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba bi shuddho3haṃ/ bum pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od 'phros laṃ ser po zhig tu gyur/ de las gser gyi bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du paṃ las padma'i sdong por gyur/ de'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ ljang gu zhig spros te yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang sngon phyag gnyis dku la bsten pa'i g.yas gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon shel gyi dril bu bsnams pa/ ba ti smug po gsol ba zhig tu gyur/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i oṃ las hūm̐ ljang gu 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gong dang mtshungs pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil bar gyur/

gzungs thag blangs la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi lha la phog pas thugs rgyud (444)bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phog pas mnyes nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer gyi tshul du byon te nam mkha'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la thim/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bum nang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la phog /de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ i ho shuddhe shuddhe/ bi ho shuddhe shuddhe/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe/ a bi raṃ shuddhe shuddhe/ bi raṃ shuddhe shuddhe a a a swā hā/ sngags 'di ma dpe rnams su 'dra min mang bas yid brten dka' 'dug / gangs ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dkar mer gyi zhu nas rim par thim ste bum chu dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i steng du yi ge gsum byung bas bar chad bsrung bar bsam la/ lag g.yon pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan ba'i sor mo gsum bum pa'i kha la reg ste/ gung mo la oṃ/ mdzub mo la āḥ srin lag la hūm̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a a/ zhes pas rgyas gdab/ de ltar bsgrub pa tshar nas las la sbyar ba ni/ nangs par 'bru gsum brjod pas yig 'bru las 'od 'phros/ shar nas na bza' dkar mo ke ke ru'i bum pa dkar po// lho nas spyan ma sngon mo bai ḍūrya bum pa sngon po// nub nas ma mā ki dmar mo padma rā ga'i bum pa dmar po// byang nas sgrol ma ljang gu ma rgad bum pa ljang gu thogs pa byon par mos/ gung mdzub kyi bum pa mgrin pa nas bzung*/ khrus sngags brjod cing lag mthil du blugs/ phrod nam mkha' gtor bas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la bdud rtsi phul bas thugs dgyes nas dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag cing rang byin gyis rlobs par bsam/ lha mo lngas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rang gi spyi bo nas mar blugs te khrus byas par mos la/

gdong bkrus pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ kha bshal bas ngag gi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ khong du btung bas yid kyi sgrib pa dag par bsam/ de nas khyor ba (445) gsum rim bzhin gtor la/ 'dod khams kyi sgrib pa dag bar gyur cig /gzugs khams kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur cig /gzugs med khams kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur cig / byas pas khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas/ nam mkha' lta bur gyur par bsam/ gnyis pa nang khrus ni/ nangs mo thog mar stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi lus 'di gser gyi bum pa/ de nang paṃ las pad sdong*/ hūm̐ las rang sems bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ spyi bor yang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sgom pa'i khyad par tsam las gzhan dmigs bzlas yongs rdzogs gong dang 'dra bar byas/ lha 'od du zhu rjes 'bru gsum gyi rgyas gdab/ de nas snod gtsang mar chab btang la mdog nag dmar ljang gu rnams ngan pas gtsang sar phos la phyi khrus bya// dkar ser dang g.yas 'khor bzang bas/ a a a a/ zhes brjod la srin lag gis dkrugs la mchod pa dang khrus sogs snga ma ltar bya'o// gnyis pa sgo gsum las kyi spyod pa la gsum/ lus dwangs ba'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal/ ngag dwangs ba'i sgo nas sngags bzlas/ yid dwangs ba'i sgo nas bsam gtan bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ lag pa thal mo sbyar la/ rang gi snying nang na oṃ kha dog lnga dang ldan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam/ badzra sa mā dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes se gol bsnol la brdab ba dang sngags brjod pa lan gsum bya/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dgyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam/ yang oṃ las 'od zer byung thal mo'i nang du rin po che la sogs pa mchod pa'i rdzas dpag tu med pas gang*/ phyag re re bzhin rdzas rnams len re phul bar bsam/ bla ma la sogs pa'i zhabs la mgo bos gtugs pas sku gsung thugs las 'od zer byung lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag sangs sangs dag par bsam la/

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spang pa phun sum tshogs pa/ ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i bdag (446)nyid dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad/ yang dag pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// de nas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang bstan pa'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal ba/ ma rig las kyi 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// nyon mongs nad kyi gdung ba la// chos kyi bdud rtsis gso mdzad pa// dus gsum bla ma rnams la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba thams cad dbyer med dbyings mnyam yang*// bsnyen bskur dag gis mchod cing dbu la bkod// dngos grub rnam gnyis myur tu ster mdzad pa'i// rigs lnga he ru ka la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*// 'dod par rgyug pa'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// ma srid byams pa'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma// phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum las kyi nang nas 'khor ba'i ru bzlog pa// nyon mongs thal ba'i gnas nas byang chub myu gu bskyed: srid dang 'das phyir 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: /bcom ldan lha'i lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa ni/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa'i snying po/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes lan nyer gcig sogs brjod pa'i rang sgras bde bar gshegs pa rnams thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul zhing dgyes/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dag cing grol bar bsam/ gsum pa ni/

nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bsdu// de rnams bla ma la/ (447 )bla ma yi dam la/ yi dam hūm̐ yig la/ de nyid zhabs kyu/ 'a chung*/ ha yig /zla tshes/ thig le'i bar du rim par bsdu/ thig le smin mtshams gyi nam mkhar yod pa la sems bzung*/ mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas spyi gtsug nas rtsa a ba dhū tir thim par bsams brda bzhi'i tshul gyis mnyam par gzhag go /gsum pa sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs ni logs su bkod pa ltar ro// bzhi pa snying po ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'dir bskyed pa'i phrin las bstan te/ de la gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par rten dang dkyil 'khor skabs dang mthun par bkram/ phyi mchod rnams pa lnga/ mchod yon/ bdud rtsi/ gtor ma/ rakta rnams bsham/ khyad par gtor chog la/ bla ma dang yi dam la re re/ mkha' 'gro zhing skyes la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ las skyes la dkar gsum/ sngags skyes la a mṛ tas brgyan pa bcas gsum bsham/ sgrub pa po stan bde bar 'dug ste brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bya/ sgrub pa'i dbu brtsam pa sogs dgos pa yod na phyi rgyud la dkar gtor btang zhing phrin las bcol/ gshegs la gtor ma bsdos te bden pa bdar la bka' bsgo/ oṃ badzra yaksha kro dha ha la ha la hūm̐/ oṃ sumbha ni be ga ti rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pa'i drag sngags lnga'am bdun brjod la bgegs bskrad/ de nas skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i khyad par dang*/ gsang sngags yang dag gi lha tshogs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog

/chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra (448)bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la skyabs su mchi'o// mkhyen rab kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la skyabs su mchi'o// thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la skyabs su mchi'o// mthu stobs kyi bdag po dpal phyag na rdo rje la skyabs su mchi'o// rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs// nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi// dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do// phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos// ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang*// mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la// gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi'o// bskul ba'i sa nas bzhengs nas kyang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// ma grol ba ni rnam grol phyir// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// bdag la gnas pa'i lus 'di ni// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la 'bul// tshe rabs bsags pa'i las rnams kun// bsdus ste byang chub mchog tu bsngo// bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams bcom byas te// skye rga na 'chi rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / ces lan gsum bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi lung rnam pa bdun gyis nub gcig gis phrin las gzhung bsrang ba la/ dang po bgegs bsrung ba 'bar ba mtshams kyi lung du mtshams bcad pa la gsum/ mtshon cha/ khro bo// stong nyid do// dang po ni/ bdag nyid skad cig gis dpal chen he ru ka gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i skur gyur bar bsam la/

hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba (449)mchog gi dkyil 'khor 'dir// yang dag don la mi brtson zhing*// 'byung po dam med thams cad kun// rang rang gnas su bde bar dengs// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na// bcom ldan dpal chen khros nas ni// bar chad sbyor ba thal bar rlog /mtshon cha 'bar ba'i gur gyis gtams// oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: tsakra hūm̐ phaṭa: kharga hūm̐ phaṭa: kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rang dpal he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mtshon cha lngas bgegs bskrad/ phyogs mtshams thams cad rwa ba dang gur gyis gtams par gyur ba phyi la me ri'o// ā ko ṭa ya muṅga ra hūm̐ phaṭa: dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer las mtshon cha lnga'i tshogs spros pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus pa las phyogs mtshams thams cad rā ba dang gur gyis gtams pa'i phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me phung rab tu 'bar bar gyur/ bsdu na de tsam gyis 'thus bas/ 'og gi khro bo'i mtshams la 'jug /rgyal bar 'dod na/ hūm̐/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla brel// rdo rje'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i sa gzhi gcal du bkram// bar snang rdo rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs// rdo rje'i 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar// rdo rje'i glog 'khyug khyugs se khyug /rdo rje'i thog 'bebs lam se lam// rdo rje'i me 'bar ya la la// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad kun// thams cad rdo rje 'bar bas gtams// rdo rjes gtams pa'i gzhal yas 'dir// 'byung ba rlung yang mi 'gyu zhing*// chu la zag pa'i gsang med cing*// 'byung po log 'dren smos ci dgos// nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ bcom ldan dpal chen khros nas ni// bar chad sbyor ba thal bar rlog

/rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur gyis gtams/ badzra hūm̐ phaṭa: steng yang phur pa'i bla bre la// 'gre/ steng yang dbyug to'i bra bre la/ 'gre/ steng yang me yi bla bre la/ me yi thog= 'og kyang me yi= me yi sa=(450)bar snang me yi= me yi 'du 'phro rab tu 'bar/ me yi glog= me yi thog= bskal pa'i me 'bar= me yi tsha= phyogs mtshams= thams cad me phung 'bar= me ris gtams pa'i sogs 'gre/ e raṃ phaṭa raṃ dzwa la raṃ/ gnyis pa la bsdu na/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// phyogs bcu stong gi 'jig rten na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang rigs lnga khrag 'thung tshogs// khro bo'i sprul pas nam mkha' gang*// khro mo'i sprul pas sa gzhi gang*// ma tshogs dbang phyug bar snang gang*// kun kyang rigs lnga khrag 'thung tshogs// rigs lnga'i mtshams las bgegs ma 'da'// brgya las 'das na rdul du rlog / ces pa tsam gyi mthar sngags rnams brjod/ rgyas par spro na re re bzhin sbyar te/ hūm̐/ stong gsum= dbus phyogs stong = skye 'gro= kun kyang buddha= khro bo'i= khro mo'i= ma tshogs= kun kyang buddha= buddha'i mtshams= brgya la= oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ buddha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ des 'gres te/ shar phyogs= badzra= oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ lho phyogs steng= ratna= oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ ratna rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ nub phyogs= padma= oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ padma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ byang phyogs stong gi= karma= oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ karma rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ gsum pa ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka

/nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// chos rnams rang bzhin ye nas stong pa las// rnam rtog 'khrul pa 'byung ba'i gzhi med de// bgegs kyang rang gi sems las byung*// stong pa nyid kyi mtshams bcad do// bgegs zhes bya ba'i ming yang med//

chos kyi steng 'og (451) mtshon cha dang*/ khro bo'i bar mtshams med par btab pa na bsam/ dbyings gyis mtshams bcad do// zhes stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo// gnyis pa tshogs bsags sgrib sbyang gi lung du tha mal pas dbyangs dang bcas pas bshags par bya ba ni/ gdung shugs dbyangs dang bcas pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha' yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs/ steng phyogs su bla ma/ g.yas su dpa' bo// g.yon du mkha' 'gro/ mdun du chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams gsal bar gyur/ hūm̐/ dus gsum bde gshegs rnams kyi spyan snga ru// mtshan nyid don ma rtogs pa mthol lo bshags// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi spyan snga ru// dam tshig mos gus chung ba mthol lo bshags// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan snga ru// bsnyen sgrub tshad du ma bskyal mthol lo bshags// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan snga ru// mchod bstod gzhung ma skyong ba mthol lo bshags// ma srin mkha' 'gro rnams kyi spyan snga ru// gtor ma dus gsum ma thed mthol lo bshags// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi spyan snga ru// dam rdzas tshangs par ma bsags mthol lo bshags// mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan snga ru// dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags// dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan snga ru// drin len len gyis ma lon mthol lo bshags// khams gsum sems can rnams kyi spyan snga ru// theg chen byang sems chung ba mthol lo bshags/ zhes bshags pa dang bzod gsol bya'o// gsum pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa'i lung las sman brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ raṃ kaṃ las rlung me thod sgyed kyi steng du a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon 'bru bcu las sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar gyur pa/ rlung gis me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres pa'i rlangs (452)pa las oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste dam tshig gi rdzas dang ro gcig tu gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ lan lnga'am bdun bzla/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las bhañdza'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ 'bru gsum 'od du zhu ba las bza' bca' btung ba 'dod pa'i yon tan ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ lnga'am bdun/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las padma'i bhañdza 'i nang du ra las rgyu drug bsgral ba'i rakta'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal la hūm̐ hrīḥthā/ lnga'am bdun/ phyi mchod brlab pa ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas so so thogs pas nam mkha'i khams khengs par gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ des 'gres te/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai bi dya/ shabda 'i bar sbyar/ de dag spyir brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā ka pā la kha kha// da na da na// dzwa la si ta/ shrī he ru ka /a me du me/ si tod pa/ bha ba be da/ sa ra ha ne/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ma hā sā dha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ oṃ aḥhūm̐/ ma hā yo ga ad dha ma hā sa ma ya/ a su ro ho: ka ma la shrī he ru/ ma hā su ma le/ a nu sa ma/ dza li ni ra na/ a ba lo ka /ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes brjod la rol mo bya/ spros pa la dga' na 'di'i gong du bab drug gis byin dbab kyang chog go /bzhi pa bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lung du yang dag mngon rdzogs zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ dang po ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum bsgom pa las/ de bzhin nyid ni/ hūm̐/ 'di tshe sangs rgyas bsgrub bya'i phyir// sku gsum sa la gom par bya// dang po chos kyi dbyings nyid las// dmigs pa med pa'i (453)don gcig bsgom/ zhes dbyings spros bral nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag

/kun snang ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis// thams cad du ni khyab par bsam/ ye shes kyi rtsal snang snying rje chen pos sems can kun la khyab par bsgom/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung 'khrugs pa bzhin// 'bar ba'i tshogs ni bsam par bya// stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa las rang gi sems nyid oṃ yig kha dog lnga ldan zhig tu gsal/ de'ang thig le mthing*/ zla tshes dkar/ na ro ser/ a yig dmar/ 'a ljang gu'o// de las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ rgyu'i oṃ las e yaṃ paṃ laṃ suṃ raṃ rnams rim par 'phros/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum 'byam klas pa'i dbyings su/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu zla gam/ paṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po// laṃ las gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi ser po// suṃ las rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa'i ri rab/ raṃ las me dpung gi srung 'khor dang bcas pa ste 'byung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor yum lnga'i mkha' klong gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ri rab kyi steng du bhrūm̐ spros pa las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ spros pa las dpal he ru ka'i skur gyur/ de'ang don dam pa'i dbyings gcig la gdul bya'i snang bar sku dang zhing khams rnam pa lngar shar ba ste/ oṃ gu laṃ maṇḍal hūm̐/ dbus kyi zhing khams ser po gser gyi rang bzhin/ oṃ ke ru maṇḍal hūm̐/ shar phyogs zhing khams dkar po ke ke ru'i rang bzhin/ oṃ bai ḍūrya maṇḍal hūm̐/ lho phyogs zhing khams sngon po rang bzhin/ oṃ padma rā ga maṇḍal hūm̐/ nub phyogs zhing khams dmar po padma rā ga'i rang bzhin/ oṃ int+ra ni la maṇḍal hūm̐/ byang phyogs zhing khams ljang gu ind+ra nī la'i rang bzhin/ de lnga la (454)padma rab tu rgyas pa'i gdan lnga'i steng du a tsand+ra maṇḍal hūm̐// steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ ma sūrya maṇḍal hūm̐/

'og nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ste de dag 'od zer 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang re rer gyur/ de dag gi nang du/ bti tiṣṭha maṇḍal hūm̐/ chos 'byung bsnol ma zur drug pa/ de dag gi dbus su/ bhruṃ ti ṣṭha padma maṇḍal hūm̐/ padma'i gdan ge sar dang bcas pa 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba la nyi zla dang dregs pa khyo shug bsnol pa'i gdan rnams su gyur/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ dbus su lha chen pho mo'i gdan la dpal mngon rdzogs rgyal po buddha he ru ka ser po gung lang gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/ yum swa sti badzra bde ba stobs ldan mas 'khyud pa/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ shar du dri za pho mo'i gdan la badzra he ru ka yab yum dkar po ke ke ru'i mdog can/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ lhor gshin rje'i gdan la ratna he ru ka yab yum sngon po bai ḍūrya'i mdog can/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ nub tu klu bdud kyi gdan la padma he ru ka yab yum dmar po padma rā ga'i mdog can/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri staṃ/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi gdan la karma he ru ka yab yum ljang gu i nd+ra'i mdog lta bu/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ cung zad khros shing zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ yab rnams kyi phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'di sgrub thabs ltar yin la/ lhan thabs ltar na/ g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pas g.yon ka pā la klad khrag gi gang ba dkrugs pa'i tshul can/ ces 'byung*/ dar ba ti sngon po'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams kyis (455)dbu skra phyed mthur du grol zhing zhabs brkyang bskum gyi tshul can/ yum rnams skra grol zhing phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra bas mgul nas 'khyud pa/

ye shes kyi rang 'od 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa'o// de rnams kyang chos dbyings mngon rdzogs rgyal po gcig las ma g.yos kyang mos blos mthong tshul du phyogs gang nas bltas pa de dang mthun pa'i rigs kyi sku dang zhing khams su snang ba'o// chos 'byung gi zur drug la/ phag mo// gshin rje ma/ rmongs byed ma/ skyod byed ma/ skrag byed ma/ tsaṇḍi ka rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa/ ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsi'i thod pa bsnams shing kha ṭwāṃ ga dku la brten pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ de'i phyi rol tu gnas kyi ma mo// yul gyi phra man/ sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi/ dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad sogs sprul pa yang sprul dpag tu med pa nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul du rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor chen por gsal bar gyur/ gzhung tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni/ /'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor yum lnga'i mkha' dbyings su// mngon par dga' ba rin chen gzhal yas khang*// nyi zla padma 'od kyi kha sbyor nang*// e bsnol zur drug ze'u 'bru brdal ba yi// dregs pa khyo shugs nyi zla padma'i steng*// mngon rdzogs rgyal po buddha he ru ka /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku sngon ser// rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ ba ti sngon po'i sham thabs can// dbu skra cung zad thur du 'phyangs// zhi ba'i mdangs la cung zad khro// g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu bsnams// g.yon na dngul dkar dril bu bsnams// phyag de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud// yum (456)bde stobs dang ldan pa ni// yab dang 'khril sbyor phyag gnyis 'khyud// sku mdog yab 'dra dbu skra grol// bdag nyid gsal ba'i thugs ka nas// yi ge oṃ ni kha dog lnga// shin tu gsal bar bsgom par bya// shar phyogs zhing khams dkar po la/ badzra he ru yab yum dkar// lho phyogs zhing khams mthing ga la// ratna he ru yab yum mthing*// nub phyogs zhing khams dmar po la// padma he ru yab yum dmar// byang phyogs zhing khams ljang gu la// karma he ru yab yum ljang*// 'bar ba'i gar dgu khro tshul rdzogs// skad cig dran rdzogs tsam gyis ni// rnam pa lha la rang bzhin med// mtshan nyid spros pa thams cad bral// bde gsal mi rtog dbyings kyi ngang*// gang nas bltas pa de ltar snang*// don la dpal chen gcig nyid du// mngon rdzogs rgyal po che ba'i mchog

/spyi dpal bla na med pa'o// de dag gis bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor song nas/ de nyid rdzogs byed kyi yan lag drang bstim mchod bshags rnams bya dgos pas thog mar ye shes pa spyan drangs ba ni/ de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'og min nas ye shes pa spyan drangs par gyur/ hūm̐/ 'og min bde gshegs pho brang nas// dpal chen khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas// gnas 'dir brtse phyir gshegs su gsol/ oṃ e hya hi buddha shrī he ru buddha kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la dam tshig bas phyag byas par bsam la/ hūm̐/ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa las// bdud 'dul khro tshogs dag pa'i sku sprul pa// bcom ldan dpal chen 'khor dang bcas pa la// gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo// a la la ho// a ti pū ho// pra ti tstsha ho// ya mi na mo// phyag phyes pas lha ye shes sems dpa' (457)dgyes nas sku gsung thugs kyis bdag dam tshig sems dpa'i lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sems can don phyir nan tan mchog bskyed cing*// ye shes thugs rjes bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// bcom ldan dpal chen he ru 'khor dang bcas// dngos grub stsol phyir brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐/ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa gtso 'khor so so la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ de nas phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten thams cad na// bcom ldan dpal gyi phyag rgyar gsal// sku gsum gnyis med bde chen gsal// phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa bzhes/ a la la ho: zhes snang srid thams cad dpal chen po'i skur gsal bar blta'o// de nas rigs lnga he ru ka la bstad cing bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ dbus phyogs gu lang gser gyi zhing khams nas// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer shar ba bzhin// buddha he ru ka 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs su// rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// bdud rtsi chen po lags par ngo ma shes// dngos grub chen po lags par zhal ma 'dzom// de yang mi 'chab gnod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// shar phyogs ke ke ru dkar po'i zhing khams nas// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer shar ba bzhin// badzra he ru ka 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la (458)phyag 'tshal bstod// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs su// rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// bdud rtsi chen por lags par ngo ma shes// dngos grub chen po lags pa zhal ma 'dzom// de yang mi 'chab gnong ba'i sems kyi mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// lho phyogs rin chen bai ḍūrya sngon po'i zhing khams nas// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer shar ba bzhin// ratna he ru ka 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs su// rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// bdud rtsi chen por lags par ngo ma shes// dngos grub chen po lags par zhal ma 'dzom// de yang mi 'chab gnong ba'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// nub phyogs padma rā ga dmar po'i zhing khams nas// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer shar ba bzhin// padma he ru ka 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs su// rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// bdud rtsi chen por lags par ngo ma shes// dngos grub chen po lags par zhal ma 'dzom// de yang mi 'chab gnong ba'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// byang phyogs (459)inda nī la ljang gu'i zhing khams nas// nyi ma stong gi 'od zer shar ba bzhin// karma he ru ka 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du// dpal ldan gzi brjid 'bar la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don ma rtogs// sems nyid mnyam pa nyid kyi don rtogs su// rang sems byang chub sems su ma 'byongs pas// bdud rtsi chen po lags par ngo ma shes// dngos grub chen po lags par zhal ma 'dzom// de yang mi 'chab gnong ba'i sems kyi mthol lo bshags// mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/

de nas phyi'i mchod pa rnams pa lnga 'bul ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams rim par spros te mchod pa gnas so sor phul bas mnyes par bsam la/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhi shwa ri st+waṃ/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐/ mchod yon mdun du/ oṃ buddha sogs lha sngags re re bzhin mchod sngags kyi mgor sbyar la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra tītstshahūm̐/ me tog dbu la/ oṃ badzra dhu pe pra tītstsha hūm̐/ bdug spos shangs la/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pra tī tstsha hūm̐/ mar me spyan la/ oṃ badzra gandhe pra tī tstsha hūm̐/ dri chab thugs la/ oṃ badzra nai wi dya pra tī tstsha hūm̐/ zhal zas zhal la/ oṃ badzra shapta pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ rol mo snyan la/ mngon rdzogs yab yum 'khor bcas la// mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// rol du oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes pas gtso bo la 'bul/ rigs bzhi la des 'gres te/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ zhes pa la/ ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar so sor sbyar ba'i mthar/ badzra khrag 'thung yab yum sogs tshig rkang gnyis sngags bcas/ oṃ ratna shrī sogs mchod sngags dang*/ ratna khrag 'thung yab yum sogs/ oṃ padma shri sogs mchod sngags dang*/ padma khrag 'thung (460)yab yum sogs/ oṃ karma shrī sogs mchod sngags dang*/ karma khrag 'thung yab yum sogs so sor skyar/ de nas gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs sngags/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā ka pā la sogs kyi mthar/ ga ṇa ta na/ bha smin sa la/ a smin pa la ya sa to ho// a pa la go / zhes btags pas kyang mchod/ de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni// byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman phud sbrengs la/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// 'byung ba'i bcud bsdus 'bras bu bdud rtsi bcud// yum chen ma mā ki ru byin rlabs nas// rgya mtsho chu klung mtsho bran man chad nas// zil pa'i thig pa'i brlan gyi bcud bsdus te// 'bru bcud stong la sbyar ba'i dza gad dpa' bos bskang*// dus gsum rgyal ba yab yum mchod pa dang*// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang ba dang*/

'gro ba ma lus thugs rjes bzung ba'i phyir// nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di// ji snyed bla ma yi dam dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas la// bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags na// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi// bcom ldan dpal chen yab yum dang*// lha mo brgyad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi// phra men seng ha brgyad/ ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ bka' skyong mkha' 'gro sde gsum/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes bdud rtsi phul bas/ sku gsung thugs mnyes nas thod pa'i nang du dngos grub oṃ āḥhūm̐ byung rang gi mtheb srin gyis blangs la lce thog tu bzhag pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par bsam la/ hūm̐/ 'phrul zhal bhandha'i snod mchog tu// dpa' bo 'bru gsum (461)tshul du ni// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub 'di// sgrub mchog bdag la stsal du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wāka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum du thig le bya'o// de nas gtor ma la dus bzhir gsungs pa las 'dir mchod gtor gyi dus ltar dmigs la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir// dpal chen yab yum mchod pa dang*// ma srid rgya mtsho ma lus brten pa dang*// rdo rje rgyal po rgyal theb king ka ra// mched lcam 'dus pa'i g.yar dam bskang pa'i phyir// rin chen tshang pa'i gtor gzhong chen po ru// zhal zas bdud rtsi sha chen dang*// rakta dmar dang dkar gyis brgyan// 'byor tshogs bshams pa'i longs spyod 'di// zhing khams rgyas par bskang nas 'bul lags na// sngags bdag chen mos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gtor mar sman raka sbreng ngo*//

brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi// buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hī/ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gau rim brgyad/ sing ha ma brgyad/ sgom bzhi/ dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mkha' 'gro sde gsum/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes stong gsum bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas so so'i zhal du stob par bsam/ de nas rakta 'bul ba ni/ chang phud dang sbyar te 'bul la/ hūm̐/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgongs pa sgrub pa dang*// ma srid rgya mtsho ma lus bsten pa dang*// dpal chen ma mo'i thugs (462)dam bskang ba'i phyir// padma zil thig dri dang sbyar ba yis// dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba'i rakta 'di// mnga' bdag chen pos bzhes la byin gyis rlobs/ zhes pas gtor ma sbreng ngo*// de nas/ hūm̐/ thugs rje chags pa'i rang bzhin gyis// 'gro ba'i don la dmigs pa yi// rakta dmar gyi ārghaṃ 'di// bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong srung ma ma lus la// brtse ba'i sems kyis 'bul lags kyi// thugs rjes dgongs la bzhes su gsol// ma hā rakta kha ra khā hi: zhes dbul lo// de nas phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa ni/ dpal chen yab yum rnams kyi sku shin tu gsal bar bltas la/ hūm̐/ mi gnas dpal chen mngon rdzogs he ru ka /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po phul bas mnyes par bsam mo// 'jig rten pa la'ang dbul lo/

rnam dag chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar gsal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig brjod/ de nas kha bskang ba'i phyir bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug khro rgyal gtso// dpal chen he ru ka ni mtha' dang mnyam// dus drug chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs dang 'gal ba mchis na bzod par gsol// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams// gnong zhing 'gal 'khrul mchis pa mthol lo bshags// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po ni chos nyid thugs su chud// ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs kyang*// mi dge log pa'i las rnams ci bgyis pa// bstan pa srung ba rnams la bzod par gsol// 'da' ka khas blang dam las g.yel gyur te// rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/ (463sbyor sgrol mchod pa ting 'dzin ma bshams te// kro dhī shwa ri'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// rdzas dang phyag rgya mngon du ma gyur te// gau ri ma brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// sha khrag mchod pa gzhung bzhin ma bshams pa// sing ha ma brgyad thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi ma gsal te// rta gdong sgo ma bzhi yi thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// yo byad tshogs nas tshogs kyi phud nyams pas// mkha' 'gro dbang phyug thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// tshogs la rol nas lhag ma ma lus pas// ma mo brtan ma'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol// sku bskyed khro bo'i lus su ma gyur pas// sngags 'jug pho nya'i thugs dang ci 'gal ba// thugs rje che mnga' khyed la bzod par gsol/

ces me tog dor la bzod gsol bya'o// don lnga pa yang dag thugs kyi mngon rdzogs rgyal po la 'dzab dbul ba ni/ bzlas brjod bsnyen pa'i lung du ru lu'i 'dzab bgrang bar bya ste ru lu dbyangs kyi 'dren stangs drug sogs gzhan dang 'dra/ 'dir phreng ba sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ bdag gi thugs khar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba na/ oṃ kha dog lnga pa/ thig le mthing kha/ zla tshes dkar po// a dmar po na ro ser po// 'a ljang gu de'i mtha' ma g.yas bskor du bzla ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la/ sku'i bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ gsung gi bsnyen pa/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhī shwa ri st+waṃ// (464)ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ thugs kyi bsnyen pa/ oṃ badzra shrī he ru ka badzra kro dhī shwa ri stāṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ yon tan bsken pa/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhī shwa ri stāṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ phrin las bsnyen pa/ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri stāṃ/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes sngags tshan lnga po cha snyoms su gsal la dod par bzla/ de'ang dus bzhir ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral bar bzla ba'i thun dang po la/ gnyis par nye bsnyen/ gsum par sgrub pa/ bzhi par sgrub pa chen po'i tshul du byed pa las/ dang po gsum rang don/ bzhi pa ni sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs dang 'brel ba ste de'i tshul gzhan du bkod pa ltar ro// de dag gi dus su rnam pa lha'i phyag rgya/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa/ nyams myong bde ba chen por shar ba la rnal 'byor rtse gcig tu bya'o// bzlas pa grub nas kha skong dang bcas mchod bstod mdor bsdus spyi ltar spros kyang 'gal ba med/ 'dir nges par gtor chog bya bar gsungs pas/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/

bdag gis thugs kar oṃ kha dog lnga dang ldan pa las ma dmar ser gcig lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du byung*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ lag g.yon bstan/ yang a dkar po lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du byung*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ g.yas pa bstan/ mtheb chen gnyis sbrel la/ yang hūm̐ sngon po zhig 'phros 'theb chen sbrel ba'i bar du mgo mthur la bstan pas gtor ma lan gsum du dkrugs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ g.yon pa'i nyi dkyil las bdud rtsi babs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ g.yas kyi zla dkyil las bdud rtsi babs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ g.yas bskor du dkrugs tshul bya/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa ro mchog brgya dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu hya sa ma ye sa twa hūm̐ swā hā: (465) lan bdun na mi gsum brjod/ gtor mgron bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkha' spyan drangs por bsam/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya smin mtshams bskor la/ oṃ gu ru ḍā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ sa mā dzaḥ oṃ de ba ḍā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ sa mā dzaḥ oṃ dzo ka ḍā ki ni hūm̐ hūm̐ sa mā dzaḥ gdan 'bul/ oṃ gu ru ma ngha la/ oṃ de wa ma ngha la/ oṃ dzo ki ma ngha la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma'i bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas mnyes par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ gu ru ḍa ki ni ye/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ nghe wa ḍa ki nī ye/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ dzo ka ḍā ki nī ye i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ re re la lan gsum gsum brjod do// de nas tshig bshad kyis dbul ba ni/ byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes zhig kha raṃ khā hi/ rim pa dbang gi bla ma rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes zhig kha raṃ khā hi// shes rgyud grol ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa sogs gong ltar 'gre'o// nges par ston pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi sogs/

he ru ka'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā haṃ badzra he ru ka'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i 'gre'o// ratna he ru ka'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes shig rol cig= padma he ru ka'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes= karma he ru ka'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i= he ru ka mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa= zhing las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ he ru ka'i gnas bcu dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma dang*// (466)mkha' 'gro ma 'bar ba'i gding can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi= las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// buddha rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*// rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*// rin po che'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*// padma'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ mkha' la gshegs ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes= sngags las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ dbyings kyi yum drug rje mo bcu bzhi/ sman mo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ dpal mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis/ shugs 'gro bdun cu rtsa bdun/ ma bdun sring bzhi/ 'bar ma lang ka rgya mtsho/ mkha' 'gro ma mkha' la spyod pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i gtor ma bzhes shig kha raṃ khā hi/ gzhan yang bka' dang bstan pa srung zhing 'khor dang gang zag skyong ba'i mgon po dam tshig can thams cad la/ dam rdzas bdud rtsis brgyan gyis 'bar ba'i gtor ma 'di 'bul lo// gsol lo// mchod do// zhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyi phrin las spyi ltar bcol lo// de yan chad sgrub thabs kyi dngos gzhi'o// drug pa bza' ba tshogs kyi lung du tshogs 'bul ba la don bdun gyis bstan te/

dang po tshogs rnam pa gsum gyi sta gon du bya ba la/ dgyes ldan lha'i tshogs spyan drangs pa ni 'og tu bstan/ skal ldan mi'o tshogs dam ldan gyi rnal 'byor tshogs pas 'byor ldan yo byad kyi tshogs ci 'byor yang bsham mo// gnyis pa bsang thabs rnam pa gsum gyis dri ma dag par bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ raṃ raṃ raṃ ni ye shes me yin te/ me yi snying po raṃ zhes bya// raṃ las ye shes me byung bas// bag chags ma lus bsregs par bying*/ raṃ/ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ ni ye shes rlung yin te// rlung (467)gi snying po yaṃ zhes bya// yaṃ las ye shes rlung byung bas// bag chags ma lus gtor bar bya/ yaṃ/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ ni ye shes chu yin te// chu yi snying po khaṃ zhes bya/ khaṃ las ye shes chu byung bas// bag chags ma lus bkru bar bya/ khaṃ/

gsum pa sbyong thabs rnam pa gsum gyis dngos po dang mtshan ma med par sbyang ba ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ lhag mthong gi me yis bsregs// ye shes kyi rlung gis gtor/ zhi gnas kyi chu yis bkrus pas dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma mtha' dag stong par gyur/ bzhi pa byin rlabs rnam pa gsum gyis khyad par gyi rdzas su sbyar ba ni/ stong ba'i ngang las/ tshogs gtor rin po che'i mchod sdong nor bu'i rgyal po dgos 'dod char bzhin du 'bebs pa dang*/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i lha mo mchod rdzas thogs pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho mu tig dri ma med pa'i kha dog lta bu zad mi shes pa'i gter chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ su ra to ma hā pañtsa shrī he ru ka /mant+ra dzā la ma ngha la/ kā ya wā ka tsitta/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ swā swā swā/ hā hā hā/ ma hā sa ma ya phaṭa/ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ /mi dmigs mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa las// ye shes sgyur mar rol cing gshegs su gsol/ hūm̐/ dbang phyug chen po yab yum dang*// byang chub rdo rje lcam bral dang*// khro bo'i rgyal po mtha' dag dang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*// lha dang lha min rnal 'byor pa// rnal 'byor longs spyod che la gshegs su gsol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka dri shya ho/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ badzra a ra li hrid hring*/ zhes spyan drangs/ lnga pa spro thabs rnam (468) pa gsum gyis dmigs pa so sor bzung ba ni/ ral gris tshogs rdzas rnams tsho gsum du bgos la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni shes rab ral gri ste// rin chen gter kha 'byed pa dang*// 'dod yon rnam lnga 'byung ba ste// dri med bdud rtsi 'byung ba dang*// dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod pa dang*// dug lnga rtsad nas bcad pa dang*// srog can rgyu dang srog med rgyu// 'di ni srog med rgyu yin te// snying rje med pas bsgral bar bya/

zhes zhal gsum du 'bul ba'i rdzas 'dod yon/ bdud rtsi sha khrag tu dmigs/ drug pa dbul thabs rnam pa gsum gyis bdag gi don sgrub pa ni/ dang po g.yas zhal dkar ba la dmigs te zhi ba'i lha tshogs la mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bla med mchod pa dam pa sbyar ba 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// dbang po lnga yi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ zhes mchod/ gnyis pa g.yon zhal dmar po thugs rje gshe ba'i lha tshogs la dmigs nas bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐// bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis// bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te// lus kyi srog bcad sdig pa dngos su bgyis// ngag gi rdzun smras gzhan la ngan du brjod// sems kyis blo nor log par bsam la sogs// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis sdig pa ci bgyis pa// bkram pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol// ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi bka' 'khor gnas pa'i lha srin rnams// 'di 'dra dmyal sogs shin tu mi bzod pas// gnong zhing 'gal 'khrul mchis pa bzod par gsol/ zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ gsum pa zhal dbus mthing ba la dmigs te khro bo khrag 'thung gi tshogs la stob pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ (469)khams gsum ma lus za ba'i phyir// sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ hūm̐/ nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste// 'khor ba'i drwa bar chags pa dang*// dmar chen po la rgya mtshor bskyil// 'khor gyi ma tshogs rnams dang rol// dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ka /khro rgyal khrag 'thung rngams pa'i tshogs// g.yo 'gul thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir// gzung rnams thams cad he ru ka /kau ri la sogs za byed rnams// si ha la sogs gsod byed tshogs// rta gdong la sogs 'ching sdom tshogs// dbang phyug la sogs bka' nyan tshogs// pho nya la sogs 'joms byed tshogs// chom shig 'khor ba rtsad nas chom/

ha ha ru lu mchod pa bzhes// zhes zhal du bstab par bya'o// bdun pa sbyong thabs rnam pa gsum gyis phrin las bcol ba ni/ tshogs zan ling gar bcos pa la rten byas te// sdong dgra gnod bgegs su dmigs pa dang*/ gnod sems kyi dug zhi bar byed pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes su sbyong bar byed pa'i sems kyis nga rgyal bskyed pa dang*/ bden stobs 'gugs gzhug spyi mthun dang*/ hūm̐/ 'khor gyi dmag tshogs dam tshig can// dam tshig tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol// slob dpon la ni brnyas byed cing*// rdo rje spun la 'khu byed dang*// snying nas slob dpon smad byed rnams/ ma thog myur tu drag tu khug /khro rngams 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// khro chung zhal gsum phyag drug pa// mtshon cha'i rgyal po lcags kyu yis// 'og min dga' ldan lha yul nas// ngo mthon stobs kyis drang bar bya/ zhes brjod bas khro chung mang po 'phros nas dgra bgegs gang na yod pa de lcags kyus bzung nas gzugs de la thim par bsam la// de nas rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas drag sngags so lnga pa brjod cing phur pa snying dkar nag mtshams su btab/ 'khor ba rtsad nas bcad par bsam/ mtshon cha sna tshogs (470) kyis ling ga de btugs la/ khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams la bstab par bya ste/ hūm̐/ khrag 'thung chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// 'jigs byed chen po'i tshul stan pa// dpal chen dgu dang yum chen dgu// gnyis med sbyor ba'i byin rlabs la// kau ri'i tshogs dang seng ha'i tshogs// sgo ma'i tshogs dang spor ma'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro dbang phyug chen mo'i tshogs// phung po dpal gyi zhal du bstabs// 'byung ba yum gyi zhal du bstabs// rnam shes kau ri'i zhal du bstabs// yul ni phra men zhal du bstabs// yan lag sgo ma'i zhal du bstabs// rus pa mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs/ khrag ni ma mo'i zhal du bstabs// sha ni pho nya'i zhal du bstabs// srog ni ging chen zhal du bstabs// lhag ma 'khor gyi zhal du bstabs// yas kyi bdud g.yos mchod par bzhes// mas kyi sri langs mchod par bzhes// pa khu'i rgan sri mchod par bzhes// ma bu'i byur 'dre mchod par bzhes// phu tsha'i bung sri mchod par bzhes// rnal 'byor dam sri=

sdang ba'i dgra rnams mchod par bzhes// gnod pa'i bgegs rnams= sngags kyi sngags zor mchod= chos kyi chos zor mchod par= bon gyi bon zor mchod= rgya 'dre stong mtshams mchod par bzhes// rmi lam ngan pa mchod mtshan ma ngan pa mchod par= sbyor ba rtsub pa mchod= lo skag zla zur mchod= za skag bdud zhag mchod par bzhes// mi mthun phyogs rnams mchod par bzhes// mchod bzhes dam bskang mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol/ zhes ling ga gtub pa de gtor mar dbul lo// bdun pa lhag ma mjug sdud kyi lung du lhags sdud cing gtor ma'i mjug bskyang ba'o// de la bud dang lhag ma'i mtshams sbyor ba ni/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan dpal (471)chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba// mi 'jigs sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol// chags med padma 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ba// ma chags gsung gi dngos grub stsal tu gsol// 'gro drug thugs rjes sgrol ba'i thugs mnga' ba// skye med thugs kyi dngos grub stsal tu gsol// 'gro drug smin mdzad bde pa'i don sgrub pa// phrin las rtsal gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la mig btsum nas dmod bor la tshogs gtor gyi nang nas gcig dngos grub tu blangs la bza'/ de'ang sha la babs na mthu che/ zan tshe ring*/ 'khur ba longs spyod che/ mar la rtogs par che bar bshad do// de nas tshogs rdzas rnams nang gi sbyin sreg tu longs spyod pa'i lhag ma la tshogs phud dang po dang bar pa'i cha shas bsre/ bdud rtsi'i kha phru btab la// rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i ya rkan dang ma rkan rta mgrin yab yum du gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs/ lhag gtor gyi mi gtsang ba'i dri ma sbyangs/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i sprin 'phro bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

lhag mgron mar gyi gnas mdun g.yog dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs mdun du 'khod par gyur/ hūm̐/ nam mkha' stong la dbang bsgyur pa'i// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis kyang*// da rung 'jig rten ma 'das kyi// rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// 'jig rten las kun khyod la bcol// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ bhyo/ 'jig rten bya ba las grub pa'i// 'bar ma lang ka'i rgya mtsho yang*// da rung 'jig rten ma 'das kyi// rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// 'jig rten las kun khyod la bcol// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// (472)phyogs bcur mgyogs pa'i las byed pa'i// pho nya sum brgya drug cu yang*// da rung 'jig rten ma 'das kyi// rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// 'jig rten las kun khyod la bcol// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ta krid lcam mor zhal bzhes pa'i// 'bar ma chen mo brgyad rnams kyang*// da rung 'jig rten ma 'das kyi// rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// 'jig rten las kun khyod la bcol// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// sha khrag zhal du gsol byed pa'i// dur khrod dregs pa'i ma bdun kyang*// da rung 'jig rten ma= rnam lnga'i longs spyod= 'jig rten las kun= bcol pa'i phrin las= rgyal chen sring mor zhal bzhes pa'i// sring mo chen mo bzhi rnams kyang*// da rung 'jig rten ma= rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di= 'jig rten las kun khyod= bcol pa'i phrin las= ri rab rming nas 'degs byed pa'i// dbang gi gru 'degs chen mo bzhi/ da rung 'jig rten= rnam lnga'i longs spyod= 'jig rten las kun= bcol pa'i phrin las= pha rol dmag dpung 'joms mdzad pa'i// dmag gi rgyal mo mched bzhi yang*// da rung 'jig rten ma= rnam lnga'i longs spyod= 'jig rten las kun= bcol pa'i phrin las= chos skyong srung mar dam bcas pa'i// bod khams bstan ma bcu gnyis kyang*// da rung 'jig rten ma 'das kyi// rnam lnga'i longs spyod 'di bzhes la// 'jig rten las kun khyod la bcol// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/

oṃ badzra ka la sa ya si bhyo/ zhes lhag ma phyi rol tu 'bul lo// de nas gtor mtsho gsum du bgos te/ chos dbyings kyi gtor ma gter du sbed pa ni/ hūm̐// thugs rje rang byung ye shes dkyil (473'khor du// snang srid mtshan ma'i bye brag kun// snod kyi 'jig rten dbyings su sba// snod kyang bcud kyi dbyings su sba// snod bcud skye ba med par sba// srid pa za byed gzhal yas khang*// rtsi shing bdud rtsi rang byung ste// 'byung ba lnga dang rigs lnga yang*// chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings su sba// nyon mongs dug lnga'i ngo bo yang*// ye shes lnga yi dbyings su sba// ma rig 'khrul pa'i log rtog kyang*// mnyam snang chen po'i dbyings su sba/ rdzas rnams byang chub sems su bsgom/ sngags mkhan theg mchog rgyal por bsgoms la gtor ma cha gcig po dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la gter du sba// phyag rgya lnga'i rgyas gdab la bro brdung*/ des bkra shis/ nor la mi gzan/ dngos grub 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod par gsungs/ de nas ye shes rol pa'i gtor ma sbyin sreg tu 'bul ba ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams me thab kyi gzhal yas khang du bskyed la tshogs gtor cha gcig me mchod dam sbyin sreg gi tshul du 'bul lo// thugs rje sprul pa'i gtor ma 'gro ba rnams la phan gdags shing phrin las rnams bzhi'i don 'grub par bya ba'i phyir srung ma la bskyangs te/ dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal la tshogs gtor cha gcig brtag nas/ bhyo/ shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// shar phyogs rdo rje rigs kyi bka' nyan tshogs// drug ni rnal 'byor gral na bzhugs// gcig ni thabs kyi sgo ma mdzad// dkar mo dung gi mche ba can// phyag na dung gi gzhong pa bsnams// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longs la// khyed kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas dang*// rgyu 'byor yon bdag pho mo yi// bgegs rnams bsrung la rkyen rnams zlog

/ bhyo/ lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// rin chen rigs kyi bka' nyan tshogs// drug ni rnal 'byor (474)gral na bzhugs// gcig ni thabs kyi sgo mar mdzad// ser mo gser gyi mche ba can// phyag na gser gyi gzhong pa bsnams// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longs la// khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas dang*// rgyu sbyor yon bdag pho mo yi// bgegs rnams bsrung la rkyen rnams bzlog /bhyo/ nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// padma rigs kyi bka' nyan tshogs// drug ni rnal 'byor gral na bzhugs*/gcig ni thabs kyi sgo mar mdzad// dmar mo bse yi mche ba can// phyag na bse yi gzhong pa bsnams// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longs la// khyed kyis dbang gis las mdzod cig /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas dang*/ rgyu 'byor yon bdag pho mo yi// bgegs rnams bsrung la rkyen rnams bzlog /bhyo/ byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun// las kyi rigs kyi bka' nyan tshogs// drug ni rnal 'byor gral na bzhugs// gcig ni thabs kyi sgo mar mdzad// sngon mo g.yu yi mche ba can// phyag na g.yu yi gzhongs pa bsnams// rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longs la// khyod kyi drag po'i las mdzod cig /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas dang*/ rgyu 'byor yon bdag pho mo yi// bgegs rnams bsrung la rkyen rnams bzlog / ces gtor ma sa gtsang sar spungs// dri ma yal bar sdud du mi gzhug go /gtor snod de rnams cha gsum du phye la cha gcig ma bshal bar kha yar bstan la bzhag /nang du nas sam me tog gis bkang la dkon mchog la dbul/ de la bkra shis pa'i dgos pa yod/ cha gcig bshal chu phyir dor/ bshal chu la re ba'i yi dwags tshim zhing kho thag chod pa'i dgos pa yod/ cha gcig mi bshal bar kha sbugs la/ dgra bgegs ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug la 'og tu bcug ste/

bro brdung la mnan pa bya'o// bar chad zhi nas (475) dgra bgegs mi ldang ba'i dgos pa yod/ las kyi mjug bsdu bro brdung*/ mnan pa byed pa'i dus su byin dbab cing*/ gro brdung ba yin pas/ dang po byin dbab pa ni/ a la la ho// bha ga wān/ sa ma ya ho// sa ma ya st+waṃ/ hūm̐/ 'phags mchog thugs rje can gyi dus la bab// khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la bab// byin chen dbab pa'i dus la bab// mthu chen mthu stsol bcom ldan 'das// dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das// byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das// dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das// bdag cag las kyi 'bras bu mchis bar mdzod//

zhes byin dbab bo// de nas bro brdung ba ni/ gtor gzhong kha sbubs pa'i 'og tu dgra bgegs bkug la/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// kun kyang buddha he ru ka /buddha kro dhī shwa ri stāṃ// khro bo'i sprul pas nam mkha' gang*// khro mo'i sprul pas sa gzhi gang*// khro chung sprul pas bar snang gang*// ma mo mkha' 'gro dbyings nas rol/ lta ba'i ngang la gnas pa'i phyir// bro ni bar chad med pa'i bro// tshangs pa'i dbyings su 'dren pa'i bro// glu ni bar chad med par blangs// dkyil 'khor rang la gnas pa'i phyir// tshig ni snying po 'dzab tu bgrangs/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ nyon mongs lnga la bro brdungs pas// dug lnga'i steng du sman lnga shar// nga rgyal sa la bro brdungs pas// nga rgyal spangs nas mnyam nyid shar// 'dod chags chu la bro brdungs pas// 'dod chags spangs nas bde chen shar// zhe sdang me la bro brdungs pas/ zhe sdang spangs nas stong nyid shar// phrag dog rlung la bro brdungs pas// phrag dog spangs nas mnyam nyid shar// gti mug nam mkhar bro brdungs pas// gti mug spangs nas ye shes shar/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ khri gdugs brgya shar stong (476)shar bas// ye shes nyi ma gcig shar dro// shar tsam nyid nas nub pa med// nga ni dpal chen he ru ka /rkang pa g.yas pas bro brdungs pas// rnal 'byor pho sri mnan pa'i bro// rkang pa g.yon pas bro brdungs pas// rnal 'byor mo sri mnan pa'i bro// rkang pa gnyis kas bro brdungs pas// rgyab nyan rkun bu mnan pa'i bro// rmig pa lcags kyi bro brdungs pas// sa bdag sa srin mnan pa'i bro// snga'am de ni mi sba ru// rgya mtsho chen po'i gteng du sba// mnan nam de ni mi mnan na// ri rab chen po'i rmad du sba// bskal pa brgyar yang ma ldang cig /brgya la 'das na rdul du rlog /sumbha ni sogs/

st+waṃ bha rakṣa mā ra ya nan/ zhes mnan par bya'o// 'di la rjes chog mchod bstod ma bshad pas dgos par ma mngon kyang rtog pas ma chun na spyi ltar mdo bsdus dang*/ nongs pa bshags pa'i gsol bya/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod cing rol mo bsgrag /rang don la ye shes pa mi gshegs/ gzhan don la gshegs par bshad/ tshogs mgron sogs rten dang ras bris yod na rten bzhugs gsol/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo thugs srog oṃ la bsdu/ de nyid gyen rdzogs su rim par bsdus nas thig le la thim/ de'ang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su yal bar gyur/ ces bsgoms la brda bzhi tshul bzhi dang ldan pas rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa yun ring bskyang*/ slar skad cig gis dpal chen mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lus thams cad rdo rje'i go chas gtams par gyur bar bsam la gtso sngags ru lu bcas brjod/ bsngo smon khyad par can gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di'i thog ma'i rgya mtsho khrus lung ni las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba yin pas rnam pa kun tu grub na legs shing*/ sgo gsum las kyi spyod pa ni phrin chog dkyus tsam ma grub kyang chog go /deng dus phal cher chos la dbang za zhing*// rtog ges bsnyems rnams 'di 'drar brnyas thabs rtsom// (477) gzhan dag gal chud snyoms las kho nas g.yeng*// tshul 'dir byir dor bgyid pa shin tu dkon// de phyir lhag pa'i bsam pas kun bslangs shing*// rang blos gang dpogs gsal bar bkod na yang*// nongs pa gang mchis rtsa gsum chos srung la// snying nas bshags so dag tshangs byin rlabs stsol// dge bas skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan// 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i skal ldan du// gyur nas gzhon nu bum skur mngon byang chub// khams gsum 'gro rnams dbyings su sgrol byed shog

/'di'i gzhung gi yig rnying la mngon rtogs mi gsal zhing yig nor rgyun 'byams su mngon pa'ang mang zhig snang ba sogs kyis/ khyab bdag kun mkhyen bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas/ chog bsgrigs kha gsal zhig cis kyang 'os pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal ba dang*/ rang 'dri'i blo dman la phan du re bas/ phrin las sgrub thabs lhan thabs mchan rnying rnams kyis dgongs pa bstun te klag chog gi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'am// blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub gnas su bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
